metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) over Los Angeles lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 data for tropospheric nitrogen dioxide measurements. Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2', band: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' 2. Masking strategy: This is about NO2 concentration, so cloud masking isn't the primary concern, but we should still check for valid data 3. Logic: Compare mean NO2 concentrations for Oct 1-23 in 2018, 2019, and 2021. Check if 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019. Data considerations: - Sentinel-5P launched in 2017, so all years should have data - Need to define Los Angeles geometry - Check collection sizes for each period - Calculate mean NO2 values and validate they're reasonable (not NaN, within expected range) - Output C1 if no data, C2 if no valid pixels, C3 if calculation fails Let me structure the code to: 1. Define LA geometry as a polygon 2. Get NO2 data for three time periods 3. Check collection sizes 4. Calculate mean NO2 values 5. Compare and determine answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Los Angeles area geometry var la = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-118.7, 33.6], [-118.7, 34.3], [-117.9, 34.3], [-117.9, 33.6], [-118.7, 33.6] ]]); // Function to get NO2 data for a given year function getNO2Data(year) { var startDate = year + '-10-01'; var endDate = year + '-10-24'; // Oct 1-23 inclusive var collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(la) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); return collection; } // Get collections for all three years var col2018 = getNO2Data('2018'); var col2019 = getNO2Data('2019'); var col2021 = getNO2Data('2021'); // Check collection sizes var size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); var size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); var size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log('2018 Images: ' + size2018); console.log('2019 Images: ' + size2019); console.log('2021 Images: ' + size2021); // If any collection is empty, output C1 if (size2018 === 0 || size2019 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 for each period function calculateMean(collection) { var composite = collection.mean(); var stats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: la, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats; } var stats2018 = calculateMean(col2018); var stats2019 = calculateMean(col2019); var stats2021 = calculateMean(col2021); var mean2018 = stats2018.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var count2018 = stats2018.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); var mean2019 = stats2019.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var count2019 = stats2019.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); var mean2021 = stats2021.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var count2021 = stats2021.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log('2018 Mean NO2: ' + mean2018.toFixed(6) + ' (Pixels: ' + count2018 + ')'); console.log('2019 Mean NO2: ' + mean2019.toFixed(6) + ' (Pixels: ' + count2019 + ')'); console.log('2021 Mean NO2: ' + mean2021.toFixed(6) + ' (Pixels: ' + count2021 + ')'); // Check for no valid pixels if (count2018 === 0 || count2019 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mean2018 === null || mean2019 === null || mean2021 === null || isNaN(mean2018) || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2021)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Validate NO2 values are reasonable (typical range for urban areas) if (mean2018 < 0 || mean2019 < 0 || mean2021 < 0 || mean2018 > 0.001 || mean2019 > 0.001 || mean2021 > 0.001) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if 2021 is lower than both 2018 and 2019 if (mean2021 < mean2018 && mean2021 < mean2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
